result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: truncated restaurant names in the horizontal carousel and overlapping promo badge text on a popular restaurant card.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol'), cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ellipsize gracefully with full name available on the detail view; give cards enough width so names aren’t clipped mid-word.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the green '€0 delivery' pill overlaps the food image content (noodles/bowl), reducing legibility of both the badge and the imagery.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the delivery badge (e.g. higher padding from edges, semi-opaque backdrop, or place below the image) so it doesn’t cover key parts of the photo.

issues.description: Category filter chips row shows a partially cut-off chip on the far right with no clear affordance beyond the expected carousel edge treatment.
issues.suggestion: If not intentional horizontal scroll-only, add fade/peek styling or ensure consistent chip sizing; otherwise this can be left as-is per carousel norms.

issues.description: Promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you') uses a light green on a light green background, which may reduce contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the headline color slightly or strengthen the background gradient to meet WCAG contrast guidelines.
